note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L rows with HS 73261910 (not the declared 843290/848310/870899) shipping to Jebel Ali (UAE) and Buenaventura (Colombia) on 2026-02-28, B-L numbers 1140019 and 1112136, from Nhava Sheva. Declared HS codes do not match the observed shipments — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the factual code is 73261910 (other articles of iron/steel, automotive driveline parts: end yokes, flange yokes, tube yokes, stub shafts), so the record should be corrected to 73261910 with verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Also note the claimed industry "Продукты питания и FMCG" (food/FMCG) is wrong — the company is an automotive driveline component maker at Plot No 44-59, Sector D-2 Industrial Area, Sanwer Road, Indore (MP). Domestic supply status is unknown, not none_found: the search backend was down and registry pages blocked, so absence of evidence here is a tooling gap, not proof of no domestic sales.
